N/Z are overwritten by AND #&07 two instructions later; C is identical; V differs but every V read reachable afterwards (render.6502 541, 1082, 1315, sky_off 33) is preceded by its own BIT, and compiled code, kc_part and draw_column have no BVC/BVS/PHP. D unchanged both ways. Stack: old JSR/RTS balanced, new pushes nothing. The interrupt does not call raise_address and reads none of these bytes. Y!=0: the same JSR with the same A/X/Y; only the CPY/BEQ flag effects precede it, and raise_address sets its own flags. Cycles: Y=0 old JSR 6 + STA 4 + STY 4 + AND 2 + CMP 2 + BCC 2 + LDA 2 + SBC 4 + RTS 6 = 32, new CPY 2 + BEQ taken 3 = 5 (27 saved, +1 if the 3-byte skip crosses a page); Y!=0 +4; at 44% Y=0 about 0.44*27 - 0.56*4 = 9.6 a call.
